summary.text: Nick McKinley is a Republican who was elected in 2026 to Indiana Senate District 17, which covers Grant, Huntington and Wabash counties.
He owns an insurance and financial services agency and previously served as a South Bend police officer.

paragraphs.text: According to his Indiana Senate Republican biography, McKinley earned a B.A. and M.B.A. from Bethel University in Mishawaka and completed the Indiana Law Enforcement Academy.
Earlier jobs listed on the page include business sales representative at ADT Security, reserve police officer in Winona Lake and network administrator at Paragon Medical Inc.

He is a former Marion city councilman and council president, vice president of the Marion Redevelopment Commission, chairman of the Grant County Republican Party and a past president of Grant County Rotary.
He serves on the Environmental Affairs, Commerce and Technology, Pensions and Labor, and Utilities committees.
The page says he is married to Stephanie and has six children and three grandchildren.
